title: trex config
description: Settings for trex, the Browser Pane plugin for Rex. Every key is optional; a missing key uses its default.

$schema.description: Where this schema is, so editors can complete and check the file. Leave it as it is.

default_url.x-summary: what Open Browser opens on an empty answer
default_url.description: The address an empty answer opens in Trex: Open Browser…. Default http://localhost:3000.

open_in.description: Where Trex: Open Browser… opens a Browser Pane. "split": to the right of the focused pane. "window": in a new Rex window.

side.x-summary: which side of its Browser Pane DevTools opens on
side.description: Which side of its Browser Pane a DevTools Pane opens on. Moving a DevTools Pane is remembered for the next one, until you change this value.

pick.description: Element Handoff: picking elements in a Browser Pane.

stay_on.x-summary: keep picking after a pick, until Esc
stay_on.description: true: pick mode stays on after a pick, so you can hand off several elements in a row. false: it ends after one pick.
